basis: Previously reviewed the page-2 FIA Competition Notes - Pirelli Preview screenshot and matched it to the exact PDF SHA-256 below. The sheet specifies 29.0/>=30.0 psi front and 27.5/>=28.5 psi rear slick pressures, -2.75/-1.50 degree camber limits, mandatory C1/C2 race tyres, C3 for Q3, and a 27-lap maximum across tyre history. Updated Qatar Tyres/Notes copy to attribute these prescriptions to the FIA source. Pirelli's 24 November infographic independently matches the pressures and adds a 26.5-second average pit-stop loss. The FIA sheet does not resolve Formula1.com's conflicting per-driver set totals (2/3/8 plus a Q3 Soft versus 2/4/7); these remain explicitly conflicting, not transcribed as an allocation. Existing Power Unit Information review and its separate energy/Overtake interpretation remain unchanged. On 26 November, visually reviewed the hash-matched FIA Car Display Procedure screenshot: it governs the Friday car presentation window, display-car selection and weather/logistics only, not upgrade submissions; added that distinction to Upgrades, Schedule and Notes while leaving the still-unlisted team submissions pending. Also visually reviewed Qatar Doc 5: it summons Car 11 / Sergio Perez and the Cadillac team representative over alleged late Thursday press-conference attendance, requires a report at 18:30 local on Friday 27 November, and makes no finding or penalty; added it as a note with its own collapsed source reader, separate from the carried-over Las Vegas grid penalty. The current FIA listing had no circuit-map PDF, while Formula1.com's current 2026 Lusail map is collected and live. Correction to the earlier map interpretation: visual review of FIA Lusail Event Document 5 (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_lusail_event_-_circuit_map_-_lusail_2026.pdf; SHA-256 2ecc4a2296e4c15c3b092866264b001ede07b0d28daf596156fe4aec603954c6) shows an F2 logo and Formula 2 DRS labels. It is not the Formula 1 circuit map; the previously stated 55 m / 190 m DRS points are withdrawn as F1 claims. Reviewed the current FIA Formula 1 circuit map PDF (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_qatar_grand_prix_-_competition_notes_-_circuit_map_pit_lane_drawing_emergency_exits_map_and_red_zone.pdf; SHA-256 d4e6898c25a3e5e99643a84d176732fdf405319e1d6fcf4f27758c2fdfffd3d0) and visually reviewed its substantive screenshot pages 2–5. Page 2 identifies the four normal/low-grip Straight Mode activation pairs and separately gives Overtake detection at the exit of T16 and activation 40 m after T16. Cross-checked those Overtake points against the Power Unit Information loops L24/L25 and 5,020 m / 5,078 m values; these are alternate references, not Straight Mode settings. Reviewed all substantive pages 2–7 of the FIA Race Director competition notes (https://www.fia.com/system/files/decision-document/2026_qatar_grand_prix_-_race_directors_competition_notes.pdf; SHA-256 61fae3b9f55f26aee0ceb2f7d0996a3ec577f9bd27978842a9a94c6add01a577). Updated Circuit and Notes with the current F1 map, lapping thresholds, Turn 16 lap invalidation rule and the pending post-FP2 qualifying/reconnaissance maximum. The separately rendered F2 map remains labeled as a support-series source and is not used for F1 technical claims. On 27 November, the live FIA Qatar index added Documents 8 and 9 after the 09:30Z collection. Visually read Doc 8 page 2: it lists season-to-date power-unit element counts for all 22 named drivers. Transcribed each count without interpreting red text as a sanction; added the table to Power Unit and a brief Notes reference. Visually read Doc 9 page 1: all 11 teams submitted completed scrutineering declarations before 21:52 on 26 November; represented the filing as administrative status, not a technical inspection result. Recorded each exact PDF SHA-256 in fia_sha256. On 27 November, visually reviewed the rendered FIA Qatar Technical Delegate's Report, Document 10, page 1 (SHA-256 0e2a99f3ec983dfbfe5a66530f5cb2945adf3915f4b909f494cc3bd3cb3b9f10). It records BWT Alpine car-operating personnel inside the circuit during the 13-hour period from 22:30 on 25 November to 11:30 on 26 November, 42 to 29 hours before P1; this was Alpine's second of six individual exceptions permitted in 2026 and the report says no action should be taken. Added this as a no-action note to Schedule, Notes and Penalties, not as a driver sanction.
